mapper.select: SELECT PARAM_VALUE FROM SYS_PARA WHERE PARA_CODE = #{paraCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT INSTITUTION_CODE as institutionCode, DEPT_CODE as deptCode FROM SYS_DATA_ROLE_MODULE WHERE ROLE_ID IN (SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND ROLE_DATA_TYPE IN ('01')

WITH N(DEPT_CODE)AS( SELECT DEPT_CODE from SYS_DEPARTMENT where DEPT_CODE=#{deptCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT sd1.DEPT_CODE FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT sd1,N WHERE SD1.UPPER_DEPT_CODE = N.DEPT_CODE ), M(INSTITUTION_CODE)AS( SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE from SYS_INSTITUTION where INSTITUTION_CODE=#{deptCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT si.INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION si,M WHERE si.UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE = M.INSTITUTION_CODE ) SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_CODE as ID from N UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT INSTITUTION_CODE AS ID from M
